prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a premium illustrated banner for a private fashion and jewelry creative-work studio app, one of four matching menu banners. Primary request: an elegant tactile still-life illustration, matte sculpted paper mixed with soft ceramic and linen, editorial fashion art direction, delicate but clear silhouettes, calm natural window light, gentle realistic material shadows. Color palette: warm ivory #fffaf6, muted dusty rose #dcb8c0, soft sage #b9c9bc, deep mulberry #74475c, a few subdued champagne-metal accents. Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, simple coherent group centered with all objects fully inside the frame and about 12% clear margin; enough breathing room to render at 220 to 420 CSS pixels wide. True transparent background, no rectangular backdrop, no floor line, no dark scene. Beautiful crafted editorial illustration, not cartoon emoji, not a dashboard screenshot. Text: none. Avoid all text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, people, robots, faces, checkmarks, approval seals, green lights, graphs, sparkles, confetti and cyber/network effects. This is a conceptual studio object illustration, not a real HAAR product image. Subject: two distinct quiet studio workstations side by side on small separate ivory paper platforms, one open rose-toned blank laptop silhouette and one sage-toned compact desktop tool silhouette, with two short cable ends clearly separated by a visible gap between the platforms. Emphasize distinct execution locations waiting to connect, no plugged-in connection, no running screens, no live indicators.
